events.title: Mistral launches Agentic Search — multi-step retrieval layer with search/open/navigate/read/grep tools
events.title_zh: Mistral 发布 Agentic Search——带 search/open/navigate/read/grep 五个工具的多步检索层
events.published_at_note: Official announcement dated August 20, 2026 on mistral.ai/news; docs live at docs.mistral.ai. In-window.
events.summary: Agentic Search is Mistral's retrieval layer for AI systems: instead of one-shot chunk retrieval, the model runs a multi-step loop over an existing search index using five file-system-like tools — search, open, navigate, read, and grep — iteratively finding, inspecting and verifying information inside complex documents. Two delivery routes: the Mistral Search Toolkit (open modules for ingesting, embedding and indexing data, deployable in the cloud or on-premises, for integration into your own agents and workflows) and libraries usable out of the box inside Studio and Vibe; a Search Starter App on GitHub creates a local index with default settings. The design is model-agnostic and requires no fine-tuning — retrieval quality scales with model capability rather than being capped by the chunking strategy. Reported benchmarks (default, untuned settings): FinanceBench (SEC filings) correctness from 26.7% to 86% (up to 3x); OfficeQA Pro (Treasury Bulletins) from 6.3% to 51.9% (+45.6 points); p90 latency reduced by up to 39.6%; token use reduced by up to one-third. Tested with both Mistral Medium 3.5 and Z.ai GLM-5.2.
events.why_it_matters: This attacks one-shot RAG's structural failure mode — answers that require navigating long reports, comparing sources, or reading tables and footnotes — by giving the model iterative document operations instead of better chunking. The isolation-boundary design (index stays inside your perimeter) plus the open Toolkit route makes it viable for sensitive enterprise data, and the model-agnostic framing means it can be benchmarked against and combined with other stacks. Caveats: the benchmark deltas are vendor-reported, measured on document-heavy domains, and pricing was not stated; independent reproduction is pending.

events.title: Compress and Forget: bitsandbytes quantization amplifies proactive interference in LLMs (arXiv 2608.18578)
events.title_zh: Compress and Forget：bitsandbytes 量化会放大 LLM 的前摄干扰（arXiv 2608.18578）
events.published_at_note: v1 submitted 2026-08-19T06:17:13Z; announced in the Thu, 20 Aug 2026 arXiv cs.CL digest (in-window; digest-date attribution per KB convention). Authors: Shayan Shahrabi-Farahani, Dara Rahmati (Shahid Beheshti University).
events.summary: The paper asks whether post-training quantization — the default deployment path for open-weight models — worsens proactive interference (PI): the phenomenon where retrieving an overwritten value degrades as overwrites accumulate (analogous to human working memory). Method: three precisions (FP16, INT8, INT4/NF4 via bitsandbytes) evaluated on three instruction-tuned models (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct) with a fixed retrieval task. Findings: INT4 significantly lowered accuracy under high interference in every model — e.g., Qwen2.5-7B dropped from 81.0% to 68.3% — while INT8, often assumed safe, showed a smaller but real penalty in two of three models. The effect was specific to semantically similar distractors (reversed sign under a numeric control) and was traced via ablation to the quantized transformer backbone rather than the output projection; same-key intrusion errors rose from 21.5% to 24.6% (p = 4.8e-7). Statistics: paired McNemar's tests (p <= 2.6e-6) plus mixed-effects regression across interference levels. The authors conclude that 4-bit quantization can impose an additional cost on applications using long, updatable, semantically dense contexts even when aggregate benchmark accuracy appears largely unaffected. Code and data released.
events.why_it_matters: Aggregate benchmarks stay largely flat while a behavior agent workloads actually depend on — recalling the latest version of a frequently-updated value in a long, semantically dense context — quietly degrades. Teams serving quantized open-weight models behind agent workspaces (memory systems, editable documents, tool-state tracking) should add PI-style probes to their quantization acceptance tests instead of trusting standard benchmarks. The methodology is cheap, reproducible, and released.
events.summary_zh: 论文研究 post-training 量化（开源权重模型的默认部署路径）是否会加剧前摄干扰（proactive interference, PI）：即被覆写值的检索精度随覆写次数累积而下降的现象（类比人类工作记忆）。方法：三种精度（FP16、INT8、INT4/NF4，经 bitsandbytes）× 三个 instruction-tuned 模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3、Phi-3.5-mini-instruct），固定检索任务。发现：INT4 在所有模型上都显著降低高干扰下的准确率——例如 Qwen2.5-7B 从 81.0% 降至 68.3%；常被默认安全的 INT8 在三个模型中的两个上也表现出较小但真实的损失。效应仅出现在语义相似 distractor 下（数值对照下符号反转），并通过消融定位到被量化的 transformer backbone 而非输出投影；same-key intrusion 错误从 21.5% 升至 24.6%（p = 4.8e-7）。统计：配对 McNemar 检验（p ≤ 2.6e-6）+ 跨干扰水平的混合效应回归。作者结论：即使聚合 benchmark 准确率看起来基本不受影响，4-bit 量化也会给使用长、可更新、语义密集上下文的应用带来额外代价。代码与数据已发布。

events.title: SMTrap: feedback-free, CPU-only compute-exhaustion attacks against large reasoning models via SMT conflict guidance (arXiv 2608.18921)
events.title_zh: SMTrap：基于 SMT 冲突计数引导、无需反馈且仅用 CPU 的大推理模型算力耗尽攻击（arXiv 2608.18921）
events.published_at_note: v1 submitted 2026-08-19T13:51:31Z; announced in the Thu, 20 Aug 2026 arXiv cs.CL digest (in-window; digest-date attribution per KB convention). Authors: Jian Yang, Zhenqi Feng, Zhaoyang Yu, Zhaoxin Fan, Kejian Wu, Xiaofeng Wang, Zheng Zhu, Jianjun Huang, Wei You, Bin Liang.
events.summary: Prior denial-of-service attacks on large reasoning models (LRMs) depend on model feedback — repeatedly querying the target or training a dedicated attack model — which is costly and reduces leverage. SMTrap introduces a paradigm the authors call search amplification: conflict counts from an SMT (Satisfiability Modulo Theories) solver serve as a cheap external signal to guide the synthesis of inference-heavy constraint-satisfaction-problem (CSP) queries. The key observation is that LRMs solve CSPs via trial-and-backtracking search, and higher SMT conflict counts on a CSP instance correlate with more extensive backtracking and substantially longer outputs. The framework is lightweight and CPU-only: no queries to the target model, no attack-model training, no GPU compute. Evaluations across seven frontier models reportedly show state-of-the-art LRM-DoS capability, several times stronger than existing baselines. The authors also demonstrate a tool-based mitigation — offloading the solving to a tool — that significantly cuts token usage.
events.why_it_matters: Cost exhaustion is a practical threat surface for anyone exposing reasoning models through an API or budget-limited agent tools: an attacker converts a cheap CPU-side query into expensive inference by forcing long backtracking chains. The feedback-free property weakens the usual defenses — rate limiting and query-pattern detection assume the attacker must probe the target. Mitigations are cheap and actionable: per-request token/cost ceilings, detection of solver-shaped queries, and giving models a solver tool so they offload instead of searching in-context. Recorded for defensive planning (LLM gateway / serving safeguards), consistent with the KB's serving-layer security line.
events.summary_zh: 此前针对大推理模型（LRM）的拒绝服务攻击依赖模型反馈——反复查询目标模型或训练专门的攻击模型——成本高且杠杆有限。SMTrap 提出作者称为 search amplification 的范式：用 SMT（Satisfiability Modulo Theories）求解器的 conflict count 作为廉价外部信号，引导合成推理量巨大的约束满足问题（CSP）查询。关键观察是：LRM 通过试错与回溯搜索求解 CSP，CSP 实例上更高的 SMT conflict count 与更长的回溯和显著更长的输出相关。该框架轻量且仅用 CPU：不查询目标模型、不训练攻击模型、不需要 GPU。在七个前沿模型上的评测号称达到 SOTA 的 LRM-DoS 能力，数倍强于既有基线。作者还演示了基于工具的缓解——把求解卸载给工具——可显著削减 token 用量。
